result.question: What was Apple's net income in fiscal year 2025?
result.answer: Apple's net income for fiscal year 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025) was $112,010 million, or approximately $112.0 billion [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p001]. This figure is confirmed by the XBRL fact reported in Apple's 10-K filing, which states Net income (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss) for FY 2025 as 112,010,000,000 USD [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss:2025-09-27].
